cards.mood: The piece opens with a disoriented, dreamlike atmosphere that gradually grounds itself into a steady, introspective groove during the verses.
cards.vocal: A single male vocalist delivers the performance with a smooth, breathy tenor timbre that feels intimate and slightly distant.
cards.palette: A warm, detuned synthesizer pad serves as the harmonic bedrock, present from the very beginning and sustaining through the entire track to maintain the atmospheric mood.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Neon signs blur in the cooling mist
Tracing the lines of a silent city
The pavement hums beneath the rolling tires
Midnight ghosts dancing in the streetlights
[Pre-Chorus]
Gravity pulls the heavy thoughts away
Finding light in the spaces between
[Chorus]
Drowning in the velvet blue
Where the deep and surface meet
Echoes rising like a tide
Finding home in the quiet flow
[Verse]
Glass walls reflect a steady glow
Shadows stretch across the polished floor
A single candle burns a steady path
The world slows down to a whisper
[Pre-Chorus]
Gravity pulls the heavy thoughts away
Finding light in the spaces between
[Chorus]
Drowning in the velvet blue
Where the deep and surface meet
Echoes rising like a tide
Finding home in the quiet flow
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
Time dissolves like salt in water
The pulse of the city beats slow
[Chorus]
Drowning in the velvet blue
Where the deep and surface meet
Echoes rising like a tide
Finding home in the quiet flow
[Outro]
